evidence_quote: Step 5: $20,000 (value of the wife's ring) - $5,000 (value of the ring he sold) = $15,000
question_evidence_quote: Jim buys a wedding ring for $10,000.
observed_error: The out-of-pocket calculation omits the $10,000 purchase of the first ring.
violated_condition: Out-of-pocket spending equals both ring purchase costs minus the proceeds from selling the first ring.
error_description: The response subtracts the $5,000 resale proceeds from only the wife's $20,000 ring cost, omitting the initial $10,000 ring purchase. Out-of-pocket spending must include both purchases before deducting resale proceeds. The written subtraction is executed correctly, but it uses an incomplete total purchase cost.
